verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents composing email campaigns in a drag-and-drop editor, creating campaigns via API and MCP, segmentation for audiences, and Composer, which builds the audience, drafts the content, and maps out the send strategy. Sending is implied by monthly email send limits. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on campaign audience selection and on send-now vs. scheduled-send controls, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the full compose-to-send loop.
